name: report
description: report: turn what a Claude session already worked out into a designed, cited report — one self-contained HTML page that reads as a rich scrolling document and paginates to a clean A4 PDF, plus a one-page TLDR. Ships three readings of the same argument over one claim ledger (Primer / Brief / Technical) that the reader toggles between, each independently and fully cited from one shared registry, working with JavaScript off and selectable per PDF export, opening with a required TLDR section carrying the finding and the ask. Compiles the session's evidence trail into a claim ledger first, so every number carries a locator and anything reasoned is labelled inference — including a comparison's ranked picks, which are inferences by construction, and paywalled lab verdicts, which count as evidence with the paywall stated. Light and dark both ship and both are measured; the PDF is always light. GSAP is a hard requirement on screen, covering micro-interactions and choreography, with an authored static frame keeping all of it out of the ink. Figures go through dataviz in native CSS/DOM, hand-authored SVG or TanStack Charts compiled to static SVG at build time; imagery comes from the evidence trail with full provenance. Layout direction comes from a Mobbin trawl with a took/left ledger, routed through design-craft and ux-craft.
